name: dreyzestore
description: DreyzeStore monorepo JavaScript and TypeScript tooling

scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && python scripts/validate_migrations.py && npm run build
scripts.db:migrate:local: wrangler d1 migrations apply dreyzestore-local --local --config backend/wrangler.jsonc
scripts.db:seed:local: wrangler d1 execute dreyzestore-local --local --config backend/wrangler.jsonc --file backend/seeds/dev.sql
